from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# CONSTANTS

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")

# Sec 24(b) - Self-occupied house property interest cap (old regime)
SOH_INTEREST_CAP = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 71(3A) - House property loss set-off against salary limit (old regime)
HPLOSS_SET_OFF_LIMIT = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 80CCE - Overall Chapter VI-A investment limit (old regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal("150000")

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS contribution limit (old regime)
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")

# Sec 80D - Health insurance limits (old regime)
SEC_80D_SELF_REGULAR = Decimal("25000")
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")
SEC_80D_PARENTS_REGULAR = Decimal("25000")
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old regime slabs: list of (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
OLD_SLABS_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

OLD_SLABS_60_TO_79 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

OLD_SLABS_80_PLUS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC - New tax regime slabs: list of (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
NEW_SLABS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("700000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("700000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1500000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1500000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate thresholds and limits
OLD_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT = Decimal("500000")
OLD_REBATE_MAX = Decimal("12500")

NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT = Decimal("700000")
NEW_REBATE_MAX = Decimal("25000")

# First Schedule - Surcharge thresholds, rates, and caps
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    Decimal("5000000"),
    Decimal("10000000"),
    Decimal("20000000"),
    Decimal("50000000"),
]

SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD = [
    Decimal("0.10"),
    Decimal("0.15"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
    Decimal("0.37"),
]

SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW = [
    Decimal("0.10"),
    Decimal("0.15"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 288A / 288B rounding: floor paise, then round to nearest 10."""
    whole = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    remainder = whole % Decimal("10")
    if remainder >= Decimal("5"):
        return whole + (Decimal("10") - remainder)
    else:
        return whole - remainder


def compute_slab_tax(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal("0")
    breakdown = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            break
        if upper is None:
            taxable_amount = taxable_income - lower
            desc_upper = "above"
        else:
            taxable_amount = min(taxable_income, upper) - lower
            desc_upper = str(upper)
        if taxable_amount > 0:
            tax_for_slab = taxable_amount * rate
            total_tax += tax_for_slab
            breakdown.append((f"Tax at {rate*100}% on slab {lower} to {desc_upper}", tax_for_slab))
    return total_tax, breakdown


def get_surcharge_rate(total_income: Decimal, is_new: bool) -> Decimal:
    rates = SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW if is_new else SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD
    rate = Decimal("0")
    for threshold, r in zip(SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS, rates):
        if total_income > threshold:
            rate = r
    return rate


def calculate_regime(inp: dict, is_new: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = int(inp["age"])
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp["rent_city_is_metro"])
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"]))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"]))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
    parents_senior = bool(inp["parents_senior"])

    trace = []
    income_sum = Decimal("0")

    # 1. Gross Salary
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)",
    })
    income_sum += gross_salary

    current_income = gross_salary

    # 2. HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
    hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        excess_rent = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10"))
        if excess_rent > 0:
            metro_pct = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
            limit_metro_non_metro = basic_plus_da * metro_pct
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, excess_rent, limit_metro_non_metro)
            if hra_exempt > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "HRA exemption",
                    "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                    "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A",
                })
                income_sum -= hra_exempt
                current_income -= hra_exempt

    # 3. Standard Deduction
    std_ded = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    std_ded = min(std_ded, current_income)
    if std_ded > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_ded),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia)",
        })
        income_sum -= std_ded
        current_income -= std_ded

    # 4. Income from house property (Old regime only: self-occupied house interest)
    hp_loss = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new and home_loan_interest > 0:
        allowed_interest = min(home_loan_interest, SOH_INTEREST_CAP)
        hp_loss = min(allowed_interest, HPLOSS_SET_OFF_LIMIT)
        if hp_loss > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)",
            })
            income_sum -= hp_loss
            current_income -= hp_loss

    gross_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), current_income)

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    total_deductions = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new:
        d_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        if d_80c > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80C",
                "amount": str(-d_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C",
            })
            income_sum -= d_80c
            total_deductions += d_80c

        d_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        if d_80ccd > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-d_80ccd),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)",
            })
            income_sum -= d_80ccd
            total_deductions += d_80ccd

        self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_REGULAR
        d_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)
        if d_80d_self > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80D for self and family",
                "amount": str(-d_80d_self),
                "clause": "Sec 80D(i)",
            })
            income_sum -= d_80d_self
            total_deductions += d_80d_self

        parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_REGULAR
        d_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_limit)
        if d_80d_parents > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80D for parents",
                "amount": str(-d_80d_parents),
                "clause": "Sec 80D(ii)",
            })
            income_sum -= d_80d_parents
            total_deductions += d_80d_parents

        if total_deductions > gross_total_income:
            excess = total_deductions - gross_total_income
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Chapter VI-A deduction restriction",
                "amount": str(excess),
                "clause": "Sec 80A(2)",
            })
            income_sum += excess
            total_deductions = gross_total_income

    unrounded_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), gross_total_income - total_deductions)

    # Rounding Total Income per Sec 288A
    total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    diff_income = total_income - unrounded_total_income
    if diff_income != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding of total income",
            "amount": str(diff_income),
            "clause": "Sec 288A",
        })

    # Tax computation
    if is_new:
        slabs = NEW_SLABS
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_80_PLUS
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_60_TO_79
        else:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_UNDER_60

    slab_tax, slab_breakdown = compute_slab_tax(total_income, slabs)
    for desc, amt in slab_breakdown:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": desc,
            "amount": str(amt),
            "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A" if not is_new else "Sec 115BAC",
        })

    current_tax = slab_tax

    # Rebate Sec 87A
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new:
        if total_income <= NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(current_tax, NEW_REBATE_MAX)
        else:
            # Marginal relief (new regime)
            excess_income = total_income - NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT
            if current_tax > excess_income:
                marginal_rebate = current_tax - excess_income
                rebate = marginal_rebate
    else:
        if total_income <= OLD_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(current_tax, OLD_REBATE_MAX)

    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Sec 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A",
        })
        current_tax -= rebate

    current_tax = max(Decimal("0"), current_tax)

    # Surcharge & Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(total_income, is_new)
    surcharge = current_tax * surcharge_rate

    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {surcharge_rate*100}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule - Surcharge",
        })

        # Check surcharge marginal relief against thresholds
        for threshold in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS:
            if total_income > threshold:
                tax_at_thresh, _ = compute_slab_tax(threshold, slabs)
                rebate_thresh = Decimal("0")
                if is_new:
                    if threshold <= NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT:
                        rebate_thresh = min(tax_at_thresh, NEW_REBATE_MAX)
                else:
                    if threshold <= OLD_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT:
                        rebate_thresh = min(tax_at_thresh, OLD_REBATE_MAX)
                tax_at_thresh -= rebate_thresh
                tax_at_thresh = max(Decimal("0"), tax_at_thresh)

                rate_at_thresh = get_surcharge_rate(threshold, is_new)
                surcharge_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * rate_at_thresh
                total_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh + surcharge_at_thresh

                actual_total_with_surcharge = current_tax + surcharge
                allowed_total = total_at_thresh + (total_income - threshold)
                if actual_total_with_surcharge > allowed_total:
                    relief = actual_total_with_surcharge - allowed_total
                    surcharge -= relief
                    trace.append({
                        "kind": "tax",
                        "description": "Marginal relief on surcharge",
                        "amount": str(-relief),
                        "clause": "First Schedule - Surcharge Marginal Relief",
                    })
                    break

    tax_before_cess = current_tax + surcharge

    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_before_cess * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and education cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Health and Education Cess",
        })

    unrounded_tax_payable = tax_before_cess + cess

    # Rounding Tax Payable per Sec 288B
    tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_tax_payable)
    diff_tax = tax_payable - unrounded_tax_payable
    if diff_tax != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding of tax payable",
            "amount": str(diff_tax),
            "clause": "Sec 288B",
        })

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace,
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    return {
        "old": calculate_regime(inp, is_new=False),
        "new": calculate_regime(inp, is_new=True),
    }
